title: Life changing!
body: A truly life changing app for me! I struggle with ADHD and have tried a lot of other habit tracker apps in the past and with most of the apps, I struggle with continuing to stay with the interface after a few days. It’s either because the interface is too complicated to adopt every day or that it does not feel rewarding enough. This app feels like a perfect balance. It’s minimal at the same time, customisable and easy to use.  highly recommended.
author: Abhishek__1
